# Keep native config-choice controls and decorative icons explicit

The current template nests a radio input inside each choice label, groups them with the config-type name and uses type=button for the install action. Repeated data icons have empty alt text; visual badges are marked presentation. The add-on section is excluded for MOZ_ENTERPRISE and the widget uses optional lookup for that install control. Preserve native labels and actual build variants when extending the choices. This source inspection does not prove keyboard focus, announced names or contrast in the rendered UI. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account Hub config control semantics.
